title: Studio Interfaces: dashboard widget types differ between the Add menu (11), the Type picker (10, no scatter) and the spec (20); the page block picker lacks 8 of 34 standard blocks; widget dataset help mentions a nonexistent "inline object query"
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Nine renderable widget types (column, treemap, sankey, combo, gauge, solid-gauge, kpi, bullet, radar) have no Studio entry although all 20 render when written through the API; eight standard blocks cannot be placed from Studio.

## Reproduction

1. Dashboard › Add widget menu → 11 types; select a widget › Type → 10 (no scatter).
2. Write each of the 20 spec widget types via `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/…` → all render.
3. Page designer block picker lacks record:chatter, record:approval_decision, record:approvals, record:attachments, app:launcher, global:notifications, element:record_picker, element:text_input.
4. Widget dataset field help text refers to an "inline object query above" that does not exist.

## Expected

One source of truth for widget and block types in Studio, matching the spec; help text describes real controls.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

Studio dashboard widget menus and page block palette under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Interfaces QA card.
- Business reason: Builders cannot use half the chart types the platform ships.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `dashboard widget Add menu and Type picker list different widget types, block picker missing standard blocks` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 0 hits.
- QA id: U13
